headline: Names a Missouri post office after Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge, a ceremonial change with no practical effect on services.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5323 Highway N in Cottleville, Missouri, as the "Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge Post Office." It is an honorary designation. The building still operates as a post office and mail service is not changed.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014.
